home.intro: Amlou, live ferments, marinated sardines, slow-cooked sauces — made in small batches in Casablanca with nothing added that shouldn't be.
home.storyAlt: Jars of seasonal fermented vegetables on a shelf
home.storyTitle: Food that keeps, the way our grandmothers kept it.
home.storyBody: illi started in a Casablanca kitchen with a simple rule: if it can't be made with a short list of real ingredients, we don't make it. Everything is fermented, marinated or slow-cooked in small batches, then sealed in glass.

sourced.title: Sourced close
sourced.body: Seasonal produce from local and regional farms, chosen for flavour over volume.

old.title: Kept the old way
old.body: Fermented, marinated, slow-cooked. Small batches and short ingredient lists.

nothing.title: Nothing extra
nothing.body: No additives, no shortcuts — just what the recipe needs, in reusable glass.
